# components/toaster

## Functions

### showNotice()

```ts
function showNotice(notice, toasterId): void;
```

Show a notice a hosted App asked for, on one named Toaster, with the notice's
tone choosing the Caps status dot.

| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |

| `toasterId` | `string`                                                                                               |

### Toaster()

```ts
function Toaster(__namedParameters): ReactPortal | null;
```

Sonner owns gestures, stacking, focus and lifetime; Caps owns the surface.
Colors come from the Stipe tokens in the cascade, so a `data-theme` switch
restyles open toasts; Sonner's own light and dark palettes are overridden.
